sentences.en: Try as you may, you will never win first prize.
sentences.zh: 无论你多么努力，你也赢不了头奖。

sentences.en: A prize was given in honor of the great scientist.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念这位伟大的科学家，颁发了奖项。

sentences.en: Prizes will be awarded at the end of the contest.
sentences.zh: 比赛结束后将颁发奖项。
